notes: Yamamoto-first discovery pass after rereading docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md. Six previously unrecorded performances clear RADAR admission on event-specific grounds. Final priority shape: A 2, A+ 4, S 0, S+ 0. The two Yamamoto dates were graded separately rather than automatically: September 1 earns A+ because the verified Kagawa/Osumi working trio directly extends the current recorded trio thread; September 8 is A because it offers a different verified rhythm section but no additional rare context. BEAT, Niladri Kumaar and Sacred Visions were explicitly challenged against S; A+ still captures the recommendation because each context is part of a multi-date tour or may recur beyond the premiere. No scarcity-tier candidate is introduced.

events.subtitle: Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio +1
events.category: Living master / working trio / Tokyo jazz
events.factual_description: KEYSTONE CLUB TOKYO lists 'Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio +1' for Tuesday, September 1, 2026. Doors are 6:30 PM and the performance starts at 7:30 PM; the listed music charge is ¥3,800. The current event page names Tsuyoshi Yamamoto on piano, Hiroshi Kagawa on bass and Toshio Osumi on drums. Although the billing says '+1,' no fourth performer is named on the current page, so no additional musician is inferred.

enrichment.note: Date, times, price, venue and the three named musicians are verified on the exact venue page, which also contains the reservation form. The '+1' billing is preserved but no fourth musician is invented. A Shade of Blue is a verified listening reference for the same Yamamoto/Kagawa/Osumi trio.

sources.note: Primary venue page verifying date, doors/start, price, Roppongi venue and the three announced musicians.
Contextual review documenting Yamamoto, Kagawa and Osumi as the trio on A Shade of Blue.

provenance.note: Core event facts were verified from the exact KEYSTONE CLUB TOKYO page. Repository searches for the date/title and Yamamoto on September 1 found no existing candidate before publication. An unnamed '+1' is not fabricated.

en.why_it_matters: This is more than another Yamamoto club date: Kagawa and Osumi are the trio heard with him on A Shade of Blue, giving the night a direct line into his active late-career piano-trio language. In Roppongi, that working unit also lands squarely inside RADAR's unfinished Yamamoto thread.
en.trip_verdict: If September 1 overlaps with Tokyo, actively make room for the evening in Roppongi. The working trio gives this date enough shape to build the night around without turning a regular club appearance into a reason for a dedicated Japan trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: Ésta es más que otra fecha de Yamamoto en un club: Kagawa y Osumi son el trío que toca con él en A Shade of Blue, así que la noche conecta directamente con el lenguaje de trío que Yamamoto mantiene activo en esta etapa de su carrera. En Roppongi, además, cae de lleno en el hilo todavía abierto del RADAR.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 1 de septiembre coincide con Tokio, sí le haría espacio activamente a la noche en Roppongi. La formación le da suficiente identidad para construir la noche alrededor del show, sin convertir una fecha regular de club en motivo único para un viaje dedicado a Japón.

en.why_it_matters: A second Roppongi date one week later puts Yamamoto in front of a different rhythm section, with Takanashi and Souma replacing the Kagawa/Osumi working trio. That makes it a useful view of how his piano language changes with the room's personnel rather than a duplicate listing.
en.trip_verdict: If this Tuesday fits an existing Tokyo stay, attend if convenient—especially if the other Yamamoto dates do not line up. The alternate rhythm section makes it worth knowing about, but the current facts do not ask the whole Tokyo schedule to move around it.

es.why_it_matters: Una semana después, Yamamoto vuelve a Roppongi con otra sección rítmica: Takanashi y Souma en lugar del trío habitual Kagawa/Osumi. Eso permite escuchar cómo cambia su lenguaje de piano con otra formación y evita tratar la fecha como un simple duplicado.
es.trip_verdict: Si ese martes ya cae dentro de una estancia en Tokio, iría si acomoda, sobre todo si las otras fechas de Yamamoto no embonan. La formación distinta vale la pena registrarla, pero con lo confirmado hoy no movería toda la agenda de Tokio alrededor de esta única noche.

events.category: Progressive rock / virtuoso quartet / final North American tour
events.factual_description: NJPAC presents BEAT on Monday, November 9, 2026 at 8:00 PM in Prudential Hall. The presenter describes this fall run as BEAT's last North American tour after more than 100 performances. Former King Crimson members Adrian Belew and Tony Levin are joined by Steve Vai and Terry Bozzio to perform music from Discipline, Beat and Three of a Perfect Pair.

enrichment.note: Exact NJPAC event and authorized Ticketmaster destination are verified; no Apple Music destination is supplied without exact verification.

Authorized ticket destination verifying date, time and BEAT billing.

provenance.note: Verified from NJPAC and its authorized ticket destination. Repository searches for BEAT plus Belew/Vai/Levin/Bozzio returned no existing RADAR candidate before publication.

en.why_it_matters: The reason is the exact machine onstage: two King Crimson veterans with Vai and Bozzio, applying a virtuoso but non-replica approach to the 1980s trilogy that reshaped progressive rock. The final North American tour gives the repertoire-and-lineup combination a real closing-window context.
en.trip_verdict: For the King Crimson/progressive thread, Newark is worth a deliberate regional trip and this show can anchor the night. The tour offers multiple final North American stops, so there is room to choose the geography that works rather than treating Newark as the only possible encounter.
en.listen_before: King Crimson — Discipline, Beat, Three of a Perfect Pair

es.why_it_matters: La razón es la máquina exacta que sube al escenario: dos veteranos de King Crimson con Vai y Bozzio, abordando la trilogía ochentera que cambió al rock progresivo con virtuosismo pero sin intentar copiar los discos. La última gira norteamericana le da a esa combinación de repertorio y formación una ventana real de cierre.
es.trip_verdict: Para el hilo King Crimson/progresivo, Newark sí justifica una salida regional deliberada y el show puede anclar la noche. La gira ofrece varias últimas paradas norteamericanas, así que se puede escoger la geografía que mejor funcione sin tratar Newark como la única oportunidad posible.
